parallel.requirements: Identified the task as clean-room genact behavior cloning from README and executable observations, with no web/source lookup and no wrapper dependency allowed.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Although swarm mode was injected, the parent retained all ownership and never launched AgentSwarm; it planned to later delegate modules but stayed in exploratory and skeleton work.
parallel.implementation: Created a Rust Cargo skeleton, static completions/manpage/help files, shared rng/io/util modules, module stubs, a large args parser, and patched parser behavior after CLI comparisons.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The artifact contained Cargo.toml, source files, target build files, static files, gifs, README, LICENSE, .git metadata, and the original executable, but no complete accepted delivery path was shown.
parallel.verification: Ran local cargo builds and a CLI comparison script that eventually reported PASS=63 FAIL=0 for deterministic CLI probes, but this did not cover module implementations or official packaging.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run was cancelled after parser patching; module implementations were still stubs or incomplete, final compile/package requirements were not closed, and official evaluation reported compile_failed.

serial.requirements: Identified the same clean-room genact reimplementation requirements and restrictions, including observing only the executable and bundled documentation.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Worked as a single local agent, using TodoList and a background shell harvest process but no delegation or subagents.
serial.implementation: Focused on CLI and runtime behavior analysis and generated a large harvest script/data corpus; at cancellation it had not written the Rust project skeleton or module implementation files.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The artifact mainly preserved observations, harvest data, samples, gifs, README, LICENSE, .git metadata, and the original executable, without a completed buildable replacement implementation.
serial.verification: Verified many observed CLI outputs, timings, pty behavior, and parser edge cases against the original binary, but did not verify a produced reimplementation.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run was cancelled while preparing to write CLI code; no integrated solution executable was delivered and official evaluation reported compile_failed.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the clean-room executable-reimplementation task and captured genact CLI/module requirements from README and binary runs.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same task and restrictions, including the need to observe the binary rather than obtain source or wrap it.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement recognition difference explains the outcome; both understood the core task but failed to deliver a complete accepted executable.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel received swarm-mode instructions and planned future module delegation, but status and protocol validation show zero executed subagents and no delegation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial was correctly local-only as the control run and used a background shell harvest process, not an agent delegation mechanism.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The named parallel mode did not actually decompose work across agents; compared with serial, the real difference was single-parent skeleton work versus single-parent observation harvesting.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Because no child agents ran, there were no child briefs, cross-agent contracts, child handoffs, or retry-state transfers to evaluate.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial trajectory likewise had no child briefs or handoffs; context stayed in the main agent and local files.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No cross-agent context/interface defect differentiates the attempts; both context flows were single-agent/local-workspace flows.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel advanced farther into implementation: it wrote Cargo.toml, Rust utility/parser files, module registry and stubs, built locally, and fixed parser behavior.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial invested more in observing behavior and harvesting module output; by cancellation it had planned code architecture but had not created implementation files.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel produced partial code while serial produced richer observation data; neither path completed the module implementation and packaging required by the evaluator.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: No child results existed; the only notable result lifecycle event was a local detached Bash task that the parent stopped because it was too slow.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: No child results existed; a local background shell harvest completed and was visible before cancellation, but it was not an agent result.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The result lifecycle differs only in local shell process handling, not in subagent result retrieval, inspection, joining, or takeover.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote several project files in one workspace as the parent, including Cargo.toml and source files, without concurrent agent ownership collisions.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote observation and harvest files from a local background script and did not integrate them into a replacement implementation before cancellation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: There was no cross-agent merge or shared-state conflict; the material difference is that parallel created partial source while serial accumulated data without integration.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel locally compared deterministic CLI behavior and reported PASS=63 FAIL=0, but official evaluation still failed at compile time and ran zero tests.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial verified many observations against the original executable, but no produced implementation was available for an end-to-end acceptance check.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had local harness success for a narrow CLI slice; serial had observation checks only. Neither had evaluator-aligned full-solution verification before closure.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel consumed the cell budget and was cancelled after about 2407 agent seconds, while still in parser/skeleton work.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial consumed a similar budget and was cancelled after about 2444 agent seconds, while transitioning from observation harvest toward skeleton writing.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both exhausted the run window before delivery; parallel's time went into partial code and parser fidelity, while serial's went into broader observation harvesting.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed cell/status.json evaluations are not discordant: both modes have solution_passed=false with compile_failed and all 237 tests not run. The parallel-mode attempt was nominally in swarm mode but did not execute any child agents, so its failure is best explained as an incomplete single-agent implementation attempt rather than a parallel coordination failure. Compared with serial, it wrote more partial Rust code and got a narrow CLI comparison to pass locally; serial harvested more module behavior and had not yet written the implementation. Neither produced a complete buildable accepted reimplementation before cancellation.
parallel_contributors: Produced partial Rust source and module stubs but did not complete module implementation, final assembly, or accepted packaging before timeout.
Swarm mode was enabled, but no AgentSwarm or direct child-agent calls were executed, so there was no parallel coordination episode to credit or blame.
serial_contributors: Produced a large observation and harvest corpus but no completed replacement source tree or compile script before timeout.
Remained a local-only control trajectory with no subagent delegation or parallel-control violation.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel spent more of the budget writing and locally testing a CLI skeleton; serial spent more of the budget harvesting module behavior.
Both artifacts were incomplete for official evaluation, which reported compile_failed before test execution in both modes.
evaluator_effects: Both official evaluator summaries report compile_failed and not_run test counts, so there is no pass/fail discrepancy to explain by trajectory differences.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; no retained parallel coordination labels because the parallel run did not execute child-agent or multi-agent work
